t: The Titan Straight Shank Wire Brushes 3 Piece Set provides essential accessories for surface preparation tasks. These durable wire brushes are designed for efficient rust and paint removal, as well as cleaning metal and stone surfaces. Ideal for tradespeople tackling renovation projects or workshop maintenance, such as preparing old metalwork for welding or cleaning masonry before repainting. Each set includes a 50mm wire cup brush, a 50mm wheel brush, and a 25mm pencil brush, offering versatility for various applications. Featuring robust stainless steel bristles, these brushes ensure effective material removal and longevity. They are compatible with most combi drills and power tool brands, utilising a standard 6mm straight shank for secure fitting and operating safely up to 4500rpm.
b: Versatile for Multiple Surface Prep Tasks
